en: A multi-view color postcard showing several landmarks and street scenes from the city of Pécs. The central images feature a main square with a column and statues, and a green-domed former mosque. Other panels show ornate historic buildings, a cathedral with twin towers, statues, and a tourist train. At the top right, large lettering spells out "PÉCS" next to a small outline map of Hungary filled with the national colors. The reverse side is a standard unused postcard layout with space for a message and address, plus publisher details.
